name: FoodBridge

problem.question: When did you last throw away food that was still good?
problem.line: Restaurants, caterers and homes bin their leftovers, while a charity kitchen nearby feeds 150 people with too little.

evidence.title: The problem is real, and it is huge

stats.text: tonnes of food wasted worldwide in 2022, about 19% of all food available
tonnes wasted by Indian households in 2022, about 55 kg per person
people in India are undernourished (2021 to 2023)
stats.source: FAO, State of Food Security and Nutrition 2024

clock.text: The food exists. The hunger exists. What is missing is the match, and cooked food is only safe for about four hours.
clock.sub: Food waste also drives 8 to 10% of global greenhouse-gas emissions (UNEP).

solution.title: FoodBridge connects surplus to need

steps.title: Share
steps.text: A restaurant, caterer or home posts leftover food. We work out how long it stays safe.

steps.title: Match
steps.text: Receivers who can reach it in time are alerted, nearest and best match first.

steps.title: Hand over
steps.text: A QR scan or 6-digit code confirms the handover. Points and a certificate follow.

chips: Free · no middlemen · run by the government
Plus an AI assistant that guides new users

tour.title: Product tour: every page, one slide

tiles.label: Nearby: map of food or needs

items: Food spoils before a taker is found
No proof, no trust, no data
Nearest reachable receiver alerted at once
Countdown and hold keep it moving

closing.title: Honest limits, next steps, thank you
limits: Safety is time-based; no temperature checks
Alerts are in-app and email; no SMS yet
stack: Vercel, with a Groq AI assistant

notes: ~30 sec. ICEBREAKER: ask the room when they last binned good food. Who is hurt, and why nobody can find each other in time.
~35 sec. Evidence and cost. Name the sources. The cost that matters most is time.
~30 sec. In plain words: share, match, hand over.
~50 sec. Walk the six tiles in the user's order; this is the live-demo map.
~35 sec. The differentiator: explained match, verified handover, privacy.
~25 sec. Before: hours of calls and spoiled food. After: minutes and a verified handover.
~20 sec. Limits that are true today, roadmap that follows from them, thank the judges.
